25 AI tools you need to be using daily in 2025

 1. Perplexity.ai – answers with cited sources
 2. Descript.com – edits video like a document
 3. Jasper.ai – writes marketing copy that converts
 4. RunwayML.com – creates stunning video effects
 5. ElevenLabs.io – generates realistic voice clones
 6. Notion.ai – organizes your entire workspace
 7. Otter.ai – transcribes meetings instantly
 8. Copy.ai – writes sales emails that sell
 9. Beautiful.ai – designs pitch decks automatically
 10. Photoroom.com – removes backgrounds perfectly
 11. Speechify.com – turns text into audiobooks
 12. ChatPDF.ai – analyzes documents for insights
 13. Bardeen.ai – automates repetitive tasks
 14. Zapier.com – connects all your apps
 15. Writesonic.com – creates blog posts fast
 16. Lumen5.com – turns blogs into videos
 17. Fliki.ai – generates videos from text
 18. Tome.app – builds storytelling presentations
 19. Simplified.com – all-in-one content creation
 20. Vidyo.ai – repurposes content for social
 21. Lexica.art – generates unique AI images
 22. Beatoven.ai – creates custom soundtracks
 23. Murf.ai – produces professional voiceovers
 24. Fireflies.ai – records and summarizes calls
 25. Chatbase.co – builds custom AI chatbots
